cause: Four supplied chorus rows had no independent occurrence between touching acoustic anchors. Global forced alignment still consumed their tokens, compressing the surrounding lines. Later row retries encountered backwards neighbouring boundaries.

fix.policy: Archive only an unmatched block of 2-8 repeated rows inside an acoustically closed gap, with a distinct fully matched exact-text block elsewhere. Boundary word confidence >= 0.5; reference row confidence >= 0.5. No fuzzy text deletion, no manual/locked removal.
fix.reversible: Original row snapshots are retained in repeat_cleanup, saved in the project, and restored by the editor button. Restoration itself supports Undo.
fix.duration_transfer: Reference absolute timestamps are not copied. Inference is constrained by target word and neighbouring row boundaries. An inferred duration too long for the local gap is rejected rather than squeezed.

live_test_after_user_cleared_timings.input_times: User reset all times during the first live test; the stale result was correctly rejected. Retried with the latest saved zero-time input.

regressions.reference_clock_shift_test: Moving a reference from 1s to 100s does not move the target at 200s or change its inferred duration.

limitations: Positive durations and zero overlap do not prove perceptually perfect phoneme boundaries. Ten timings remain explicitly estimated; six measured words in the reset-input live run retain review warnings. This is not a 100% acoustic accuracy claim or a new ten-song model benchmark.

initial_diagnostic_snapshot.note: Diagnostic run before the additional duration guard; final shipped behavior is measured by live_test_after_user_cleared_timings.
